tcm._note: tcm-mcp now lives in its own repo (github.com/JoinFullStackDev/tcm-mcp) — installs in ~10s / ~50MB vs the old ~1.6GB monorepo clone. It is a PRIVATE repo, so the install host needs git read access (gh auth for devs; a git token for headless agents). Export TCM_USER_TOKEN (Supabase JWT; ~1h) before launching, or set CLUTCH_API_KEY (+MCP_AGENT_USER_ID) for headless. See the tcm-mcp repo README.
